messages.content:
Review this building materials export SaaS acquisition system (score 1-10):

System: YouDing - B2B SaaS for Chinese building materials companies selling overseas

16 capabilities implemented:
1. GEO Tech Radar (22 international sources: arXiv papers, Moz/Ahrefs blogs, Google official, GitHub GEO tools)
2. GEO Writing Strategy v3 (13 tactics based on Princeton KDD 2024 + arXiv 2026 papers)
3. SEO Content Matrix (2800 counties x keywords -> AI generation -> 40+ platform publishing -> indexing monitoring)
4. GEO Engine Probe (7 AI search engines: DeepSeek/ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude/NVIDIA/Tongyi/Doubao)
5. Product Page SEO (Schema.org bilingual JSON-LD + 12 language hreflang + llms.txt)
6. Bilingual FAQ System (Chinese+English database + API)
7. Inquiry Full-funnel Attribution (6 fields: source_url/source_keyword/ai_search_engine/attribution_channel/attribution_data/customer_finder_id)
8. Customer Finder -> Auto Inquiry Creation
9. Email Reply -> Auto Negotiation
10. GEO Low Score Auto-Retry (3 retries)
11. Full-funnel Attribution Report
12. Content Feedback Loop (publish -> probe in 3 days -> indexing -> rank -> strategy adjustment)
13. Cross-tenant Industry Learning (anonymized success pattern sharing)
14. Daily Master Orchestrator (chains all steps automatically)
15. Industry Knowledge Base
16. Security Hardening (XSS DOMPurify + rate limiting + CSRF + GDPR + Redis)

Please review: architecture rationality, acquisition loop completeness, top 3 risks, priority investment areas, competitive differentiation (vs Alibaba International/Made-in-China), overall score 1-10.
